## Invitations

The outreach activity generated 2348 invitations. A total of 435 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 18.5 per cent. This provides a clear measure of participation against the number of people invited and supports review of the approach used for future engagement.

Invitations were issued through the available contact methods. Of the invitations, 2011 were sent with an SMS. This channel was therefore used for most of the outreach and provided an additional prompt for attendance.

Van days were maintained where roads allowed. This helped preserve outreach coverage in locations that could be reached safely and practically, while recognising the access limitations associated with local road conditions.

## Contact

No reminder messages were received by 0 people. The absence of reminder activity should be noted when interpreting attendance and when considering arrangements for subsequent outreach.
